chapters.reason: The paper explicitly compares the expressive power of Transformers and RNNs on compositional reasoning tasks, focusing on the architectural requirements for solving these problems.
The paper introduces 'Compositional Reasoning Questions' (CRQs) as a new family of tasks to evaluate and compare the reasoning capabilities and limitations of different architectures.

The paper discusses the necessity of embedding dimension and depth for RNNs and Transformers to solve compositional tasks, which relates to the architectural efficiency and structural properties of these models.
